deadline.value: International PhD applicants: January 31 (department page). The graduate-school program page lists March 15 for Fall; use the earlier date.
deadline.quote: Note the application deadline of January 31 each year for international doctoral candidates.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Prospective students are strongly encouraged to identify a supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students are strongly encouraged to identify a prospective supervisor prior to applying to the graduate program.

funding.value: The department financial-support page checked has no funding amounts or guarantee.

entry_route.value: A thesis-based Master's with at least 78% is required; a transfer from the MSc into the PhD is possible.
entry_route.quote: Successful completion of a thesis-based Master’s Degree in Biology or related discipline.

toefl_min.value: Biology asks for TOEFL iBT 5 overall with no section below 4.5 on the new scale (100 with no section below 23 on the old scale), higher than the graduate-school 4.5.
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, Western requires a minimum overall score of 5, with no individual section score below 4.5.

notes: IELTS 6.5 overall and in each band, the same overall score as the graduate school.
